verdict.rationale: The evidence shows llama.cpp ships a server (`llama serve -hf <model>`) with a built-in web UI, but each example loads a single model at launch. Nothing documents loading several models or switching between them at runtime without a restart. Model switching is a fair axis for an inference server, so this is "none" rather than "na".

support.subject: As a power-user, I can load and switch between multiple models without restarting the server
